$comment: engine.citizens fertility / natural-increase balance configuration (FEAT-160). Every numeric value below is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass (the balance-number regime, same convention as data/census.json's AC-16/AC-27 disclosure pattern) — tests check direction and structure, never a pinned magnitude. Units are stated per entry so a downstream consumer never has to guess whether a figure is years or a per-month probability.

meta.balanceRegime: Every numeric entry below is a disclosed placeholder pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass. Units are stated per entry.

minChildbearingAgeYears.disclosure: placeholder — lower edge of the childbearing age window (FEAT-160), pending Aaron's balance pass. A partner younger than this is never fertility-eligible.

maxChildbearingAgeYears.disclosure: placeholder — upper edge of the childbearing age window (FEAT-160), pending Aaron's balance pass. A partner older than this is never fertility-eligible.

peakFertilityAgeYears.disclosure: placeholder — age at which the per-partner fertility modifier peaks (triangular curve), pending Aaron's balance pass. Must lie within [minChildbearingAgeYears, maxChildbearingAgeYears].

baseMonthlyBirthRate.disclosure: placeholder — per-couple monthly birth probability at peak fertility for BOTH partners, before the age modifier is applied, pending Aaron's balance pass. Directional-only: tests never assert this exact figure.

maxChildrenPerHousehold.disclosure: placeholder — household child-count cap above which a couple is no longer fertility-eligible, pending Aaron's balance pass.
